note:
Prika — SR / Burst II buffer. Board: 1.065 HOT on her single graded comp (anis-star + mint + prika + alice + red-hood), which selects mode 'duet (w/ Mint)'. All five damage-relevant lines are kit-literal and pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/prika.test.ts (20 pins, green vs shipped and red vs every named counterfactual).
THE FIVE DAMAGE-RELEVANT LINES. P1 S1 full-charge → allies projectileExplosionPct 20 / 3s. P2 same block → allies pierceDamagePct 13.09 / 3s. P3 same block → allies casterAtkPct 20 (20% of PRIKA's ATK, so a flat, identical grant on every ally). P4 Encore → allies attackDamagePct 25.01 / 10s. P5 burst Performance → allies chargeDamagePct 25 / 25s. P6 is the sign that matters: Encore's 'Cooldown of Burst Skill ▲ 21 sec' is an INCREASE — the price of the Performance extension — encoded as burstCdr seconds -21 (positive burstCdr reduces), taking her 40s cooldown to 61s and giving 3 casts per 180s rather than the 9 a decrease misread would give.
MODES are load-bearing, not cosmetic. 'solo' = 25s Performance per burst with Encore proxied per Full Burst entry. 'duet (w/ Mint)' = the owner-confirmed real rotation in comps holding BOTH mint and prika: PRIKA TAKES THE FIRST BURST, THEN MINT TAKES EVERY BURST FOR THE REST OF THE FIGHT. Two mode-gated blocks implement it — a passive burstFirst (she takes burst 1 regardless of slot order, so slot order does not matter) and a burstCast burstCdr -9999 (she then locks out). ⚠ A harness that does NOT select 'duet (w/ Mint)' runs her solo, neither block fires, and she reads artificially COLD. If she ever reads far colder in one tool than another, CHECK MODE SELECTION FIRST — that is the failure this warning exists for.
ENCORE IS A PROXY. The real trigger is 'Sing Along takes effect while Prika is in Performance' — a cross-unit partner mechanic (Mint). Solo mode approximates it as firing once per Full Burst entry, which over-credits the ally Attack Damage ▲25.01% AND over-applies the self burst-cooldown ▲21s in comps with no Sing Along caster. The proxy also splits one game proc across two triggers (Effect 3 on fullBurstEnter, Effect 4 on burstCast), so in any two-B2 comp the benefit outruns the price. ⚑ OPEN, owner's call: mode-gating BOTH Encore effects to duet-only is the faithful alternative — board-moving only if a solo-prika comp is ever graded.
⚑ OPEN — DUET ENCORE WINDOW: the duet-mode Encore attackDamagePct ships durationSec 9999 against a printed 'for 10 sec'. The 're-extends Performance forever' rationale belongs to Effect 2 (Performance duration), not Effect 3 (its own 10s window). Resolve by reading Mint's Sing Along cadence: if it re-procs within 10s the 9999 stands and the reason needs re-labelling; if it rides Mint's ~40s burst, encode Effect 3 at 10s.
PIERCE IS MODELED (owner-ruled 2026-08-11: she IS Pierce-tagged during Performance). Kit, S1: 'Activates only while in Performance status. Affects self. Gains Pierce. This effect is continuous.' Encoded as two skill1 blocks, trigger burstCast, target SELF, one per mode — gainPierce durationSec 25 in 'solo' (her Performance window) and 9999 in 'duet (w/ Mint)'. NOT top-level hasPierce, which would tag her from frame 0 rather than from her cast. Consequence: her own Pierce Damage ▲13.09% now lands on her SR fire, and so do partner Pierce buffs (her graded comp seats mint, whose Singing-gated pierceDamagePct 32.72 she now also receives).
⚑ THE WINDOW, NOT THE TAG, IS THE BOARD LEVER — measured on PA MiKa 2026-08-11: no tag 0.890 · tag with a 25s duet window 0.917 · tag with the shipped 9999 duet window 1.064. The owner's ruling is worth ~+0.03; the duet WINDOW is worth ~+0.15. That 9999 is not an independent choice: it mirrors the duet chargeDamagePct, on the premise that Encore's 'Performance duration ▲21 sec' re-extends Performance for as long as mint keeps bursting, so Performance never lapses in duet. The tag and the chargeDamagePct therefore stand or fall TOGETHER — if that premise is ever refuted, move BOTH windows, never one. Do not close her HOT read by deleting the tag (owner-ruled) or by shaving 13.09 (datamined); the open question is the window.
HEAL: the burst Performance HoT's recovery CADENCE (every 1s for 25s = 25 ticks) IS modeled as heal ticks:25 intervalSec:1 on burstCast/allies, so 'when recovery takes effect' consumers (Crown-type) proc off her across the full 25s window. Only the HP MAGNITUDE (3.04% of her final max HP) is unmodeled — the engine's heal effect carries no HP amount, and there is no HP pool.
NOT MODELED: Encore's 'Performance duration ▲21 sec' (no primitive extends a named ally status window, so in solo mode the Charge Damage ▲25% and the heal run 25s instead of an extended ~46s); Encore's Singing part assignment (inert); S1's Outgoing healing ▲49.92% (no HP pool); S2's Full-Burst-enter Max HP ▲19.98% (defensive).
Prika is one of the three 5e state-machine units whose cross-unit event bus is explicitly NOT solvable by a single status registry — held, by design, not by omission.

skill2: Effect 1: Affects the member who initiated Sing Along. Assigned Part: Singing. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Effect 2: Affects all allies. Performance duration ▲ 21 sec.
burst: Effect 1 HP MAGNITUDE: Restores 3.04% of the skill user's final max HP as HP — the recovery CADENCE (every 1 sec for 25 sec = 25 ticks) IS modeled (heal ticks:25 intervalSec:1, driving on-recovery consumers); only the HP amount is not (the engine's heal effect carries no HP value). This effect cannot be removed.
